decisions.decision: AutoFilter detection accepts both 'AutoFilter' and 'AutoFilter2' class_names
decisions.rationale: Live 9/10 used 'AutoFilter'; Live 11+ uses the rebuilt 'AutoFilter2'. Same param names so same code path works.

decisions.decision: Filter-type-aware encoders 4/5 resolved by value_items label, not enum index
decisions.rationale: Live's enum ordering can change between builds; reading the displayed label is robust.

decisions.decision: Replaced 'LFO On' with 'S/C On' on Send A button; replaced 'Sidechain Mix' with 'Soft Clip On' on Send C
decisions.rationale: AutoFilter2 has no LFO on/off param; Sidechain Mix is continuous (toggle doesn't fit). Sidechain on/off + Soft Clip on/off are the two natural performance toggles.

context_notes: Today shipped 9 quick tasks + 3 debug-session fixes for the APC40 remote script — all UAT-approved except the AutoFilter mode (260504-k6p) currently at b1c3dd8. The Variations / EQ / AutoFilter feature stack is structured around: matrix-mode slots 6 (Global Variations) and 7 (per-device Variations); TRACK CONTROL MODE 3 (Shift+Send B) for EQ Smart Control with FilterEQ3 / Eq8 / ChannelEq / AutoFilter cooperating; and TRACK CONTROL MODE 2 (Shift+Send A) the new AutoFilter cockpit. Reusable lessons in SUMMARY files: parameter.is_enabled does NOT track UI greying (read upstream value); plain ButtonElement has no set_enabled / set_on_off_values (only ConfigurableButtonElement does); strip.set_send_controls fights for encoders 1/2/3 unless explicitly nulled; clip_slot.canonical_parent returns Scene on Live 12, not Track (use song.visible_tracks + session.track_offset); AutoFilter2 is the Live 11+ class_name (legacy 'AutoFilter' is Live 9/10).
